entities.summary: Jason Orville Pridie is an American former professional baseball outfielder. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) with the Minnesota Twins, New York Mets, Philadelphia Phillies, Baltimore Orioles, Colorado Rockies, and Oakland Athletics, and in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Hiroshima Toyo Carp.
